summary: Use Node interop so an ESM default import of CommonJS receives module.exports.

target.notes: Node constructs a CommonJS namespace wrapper whose default export points to module.exports.

caveats: This is Node host interop, not language-only ECMAScript behavior.

tests.name: default is exports object
tests.input:
// a.cjs: module.exports={x:1}
// main.mjs: import a from './a.cjs'; console.log(a.x);

tests.name: default can be primitive
tests.input:
// a.cjs: module.exports=7
// main.mjs: import a from './a.cjs'; console.log(a);
